title: ceratotheca integribracteata subsp. elliptica
intro: Ceratotheca integribracteata subsp. elliptica, commonly known as the Blue Lobelia, is a perennial plant species in the family Campanulaceae. The Blue Lobelia is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including the treatment of various ailments such as fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. Its therapeutic actions include anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antipyretic properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of the Blue Lobelia plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are being studied for their potential health benefits.
